_why: Derived from the topics this network actually publishes on, not from measured search demand. There is no Search Console evidence set in this repo, and inventing plausible queries would have produced a measurement of nothing. These are the terms the topic map already commits each publication to covering, so the probe answers a question the repo can stand behind: when an answer engine is asked about the things we publish on, does it cite us. Replace with measured GSC queries once this network has impression data.
queries: TRT IV hydration hair-loss peptide educational guides
self-service document creation and downloadable document kits
Memphis porch decorating hotel decor party styling grazing tables
